observedAssertions: The visible Validate and run pair control completed.
WebAssembly compiled under script-src self plus wasm-unsafe-eval; no CSP compile denial occurred.
The controlled JavaScript and linear-Wasm variants both completed correctness and fixed-work validation.
The visible status reported that the pair was stored.

limitations: The two manual validation records were intentionally removed after runtime verification and are not published as raw evidence.
